'''Preena Jallop''' owned [[Preena's Repair Bay]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vaynai/Legends|Vaynai]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] period. She also operated an educational facility known as [[Preena's Academy]] that sought to teach impoverished children the skills required to make a living as a [[Technician/Legends|repair technician]].
